controls: Every /v1 route requires Entra JWT authentication in non-local environments.
Health and OpenAPI remain anonymous and read-only.
Cosmos NoSQL uses managed identity with local key authentication disabled.
Gremlin and PostgreSQL technical credentials are referenced through Key Vault.
PostgreSQL, Cosmos NoSQL, Cosmos Gremlin, and Key Vault use private networking.
Container runs non-root with a bounded graceful shutdown and no development reload.
Deployment and teardown commands require explicit confirmations.
No live cloud mutation occurred during Gate A.
